title: Editor crash when deleting node in `SceneTreeDock::perform_node_renames`
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: Godot v4.7.dev (1aaea38e7) (master as of writing)
Reproducible in: Godot v4.7.dev (5c4500a23610d23c82513f506ad8a7e81a7319d1)
Not Reproducible in: Godot v4.7.dev (a3e84cc2af14aa4cffbefd8e13492e59567a64e3)

I've bisected the commit to 5c4500a (PR: #113479).

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev (1aaea38e7) - macOS Tahoe (26.3.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 Max (Apple7) - Apple M1 Max (10 threads) - 32.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

When deleting a node in my project, I get the below crash.  Deleting and re-generating the `.godot` folder does not avoid the crash on subsequent attempts.

When reducing to an MRP, the crash no longer occurs once the `.godot` folder has been deleted and recreated.  I've attached it nonetheless.  When I re-opened the project, a "LookAtModifier" named "HeadLookAtModifier" had been renamed (new name: ImportedModel_Armature_GeneralSkeleton#HeadLookAtModifier.)

It was underneath the an imported Blender scene's Skeleton3D. The imported Blender scene had been marked "Editable Children", and the LookAtModifier had been placed under the imported Skeleton3D.

### Steps to reproduce

- Travel back in time, before I deleted the `.godot` folder
- Try to delete any node under "Skeleton3D"
- The editor will crash with the above stack trace.

Seriously, though, my main project still fails with this exact backtrace.  

I can include an alternate MRP, but once I get it trimmed down, the `.godot` folder is 50-ish MB.  I can re-minimize and keep that if instructed.
